description:
Stonking, crashing and most-anticipated skins. The rust.wiki Insights page: `stonking` - the 10 skins trading closest to (or above) their all-time high,
`crashing` - the 10 closest to their all-time low (each `{itemdefid, name, icon_url, price, reference_price}`,
cents; the reference is that skin's own all-time high or low from Steam's multi-year history, skins with under
30 history points excluded), and `anticipated` - the 50 marketable skins with the most Steam Workshop
subscribers (`{itemdefid, name, icon_url, subscriptions}`). Refreshed with each price-history run, about every
6 hours.
name: get_market_movers
title: Stonking, crashing and most-anticipated skins
